summary: Prevents a partial or merely captured trace bundle from entering selector/cost evaluation until the NPZ and provenance manifest pass the public trace gate verifier. Acceptance here is only an evaluation-entry verdict; named-hardware timing remains a separate promotion blocker.

online_research_basis.note: Generation output length, strategy, cache_implementation, and default GenerationConfig inheritance are explicit variables, so evaluable traces must bind them before downstream evaluation.
generate() can return sequences, scores, attentions, hidden states, and cache state; verdicting should distinguish replay/evaluation artifacts from ordinary generation output.
Deterministic replay depends on software/hardware execution choices, so an accepted trace bundle still does not imply timing promotion.
CUDA timing evidence needs event/synchronization semantics and must be separated from trace-capture elapsed time.
